text:
alex g: Morning — got my M2 MBP delivered but hitting a wall with device enrollment. Addigy shows "Awaiting management profile" and prompts for an enterprise Apple ID that I don't have. Started setup at home, connected to personal Wi‑Fi. Any quick steps?

it_support: Hey Alex — welcome! Can you paste the serial number? Also confirm whether you completed the Setup Assistant network step on corporate VPN or at home.

alex g: Serial: C02XQ0ABC123. Did setup at home, no VPN. Tried turning off and on, rebooted twice.

maria c: If you can run this and paste the output it helps:

```
profiles status -type enrollment
sudo profiles renew -type enrollment
```

also, do you see a prompt titled "Company/Organization Access" asking for an Apple ID or "Enroll in MDM"?

alex g: Running now. Output: "No enrollment profiles found". I do see a prompt asking for an Apple ID during "Remote Management" step — it errors out after I enter email with "Could not verify"

addigy-bot: Automated notice: enrollment attempt for serial C02XQ0ABC123 failed — MDMLockdownError (code 1013). Retry queued.

jackson: That error usually means the device isn't assigned in Apple Business Manager (ABM) yet or the user flow is blocked. Alex — what email did you sign up with on the device? We need your corp account (okta email) or we can send an invite.

alex g: I used my personal iCloud initially, but logged out and tried okta-style email (alex.g@redwood.ai) and got same failure.

jackson: OK. I'm going to check ABM/Device Enrollment. If it's not assigned I'll attach it to your Okta identity and re-trigger the enrollment profile. Also, do you need temporary local admin to install dev tools? We can grant a one-time admin for up to 3 hours.

it_support: If you want the temp admin, confirm here and we'll add you to the "temp-local-admin" AD group and DM you the token. Note: token expires on creation and we do it via Okta session.

alex g: Yes please — I need to install Homebrew and Docker (will need Rosetta for a few x86 tools). Appreciate it.

jackson: Done — I re-assigned the serial in ABM and pushed a fresh enrollment via Addigy. You should get a notification in the Setup Assistant shortly. Also added you to temp-local-admin for 3 hours; we'll DM the approval link in ~2 mins. :thumbsup: 

addigy-bot: Enrollment re-deployed for serial C02XQ0ABC123. Status: pending user action.

alex g: Got the enrollment prompt, completed the profile install, and Addigy shows "Managed" now. Thanks folks! I'll wait for the temp-admin DM before installing.

it_support: DM sent with one-time admin approval link. Click it while connected to corp VPN. After you install, reply and we'll remove the privilege early if you want.

alex g: Clicked, got admin rights, installed Homebrew + Docker Desktop, rebooted. Confirming everything looks good.

addigy-bot: Device check-in successful after enrollment. No outstanding issues.

alex g: All set — big thanks to everyone for the quick help. Happy to file a short note for onboarding doc to mention ABM timing and the Apple ID snag.

maria c: Please do — a 1‑liner in the onboarding checklist about "don't complete Setup Assistant with a personal Apple ID; sign in with your corporate Okta email when prompted" would save others. :100:
